subject: MAP cadence reset — ownership rotation & contingency ledger
messages:
From: Helen Park <hpark@aldertech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@aldertech.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and evaluation windows

Karthik —

Quick note from procurement: our finance lead needs final SOW + PO terms before 4/15 to meet our internal quarter close. We had originally pledged the evaluation window to end 4/30, but with internal headcount allocations shifting, we will likely compress that by two weeks unless we adjust the MAP.

This could put your go-live into late May unless we either (a) shorten the evaluation cycles (risking coverage), or (b) accept a phased go-live where core API routes go first and the rest follow.

Attached is the procurement timeline they asked us to review. Can you propose a contingency plan and an updated MAP that preserves acceptance criteria? Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Helen
VP, Product Operations
AlderTech

Attachments: procurement_timeline_v2.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <hpark@aldertech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and evaluation windows

Helen — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the timeline. I pulled the MAP and flagged the acceptance gates that require full-system traffic vs those that can be validated in a scoped integration.

Immediate plan (proposal):
- Short-term: compress non-critical eval cycles by 50% (reduce load/perf soak for secondary routes) so we keep the core acceptance window intact.
- Phased launch option: agree a split cutover — core generation & routing on initial go-live, embeddings/analytics routes on a follow-up within 3 weeks.
- Risk log: create a one-page risk ledger that lists acceptance coverage lost by compression + mitigation owners.

Action items I can own by EOD Monday: updated MAP (with phased cutover option), one-page risk log, and a recommended meeting cadence to keep procurement and engineering aligned. Can the AlderTech procurement lead confirm PO ETA by Monday? If PO slips past 4/15 we will need explicit exec alignment.

Prefer a 30-minute sync early next week to confirm decisions — propose Mon 4/5 9:00am PT.

—Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: AlderTech_MAP_v1.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Helen Park <hpark@aldertech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP cadence reset — ownership rotation & contingency ledger

Adding procurement detail from our side: finance flagged that AlderTech's PO language has historically required a 45-day review for custom SLA clauses — that typically pushes effective date out. If their PO team needs that window, the earliest fully-compliant go-live would be the week of 5/24.

What helps: if AlderTech signs a limited-scope PO for the core routes (so we can mobilize infra and reserved capacity) and finalizes the full PO for the extended scope later, we can meet a late-April practical launch for critical flows. Otherwise we'll need to rebaseline to late May.

I uploaded a simple procurement checklist (see procurement_timeline_v2.xlsx) and flagged the clause that causes the most delay.

Ben
Sr. Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: procurement_timeline_v2.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Helen Park <hpark@aldertech.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Apr 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP cadence reset — ownership rotation & contingency ledger

Team — per Ben, procurement friction is the primary vector for date slippage here. Karthik, I want this tracked in the exec tracker and, if AlderTech cannot provide PO confirmation by EOD Monday 4/11, we should loop in our VP of Sales for a one-time escalation to their CFO to unblock the SLA language.

Please include the following in the risk ledger: probability (low/med/high), impact (token-cost/delivery/acceptance-quality), owner, and proposed mitigation. Keep it to one page for exec distribution.

Karthik — prioritize the phased go-live language in the MAP and call out exactly which acceptance gates move to phase 2. Send the risk ledger to me and Grace before COB on 4/6 so I can review for exec briefing.

Marissa
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Helen Park <hpark@aldertech.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Apr 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP cadence reset — ownership rotation & contingency ledger

Summary and agreed next steps (finalized after today's sync):

1) MAP update: I uploaded a phased-MAP (core / extended) with explicit acceptance gates called out. Core includes generation, core routing, and safety checks. Extended includes embeddings-backed features and analytics. (See AlderTech_MAP_v1.pdf)

2) Risk ledger: attached risk-log-template.csv filled with three items — PO delay, reduced soak coverage, and quantization regression risk if we shorten perf cycles. Owners assigned: Ben (procurement escalation), Grace (QA soak prioritization), Karthik (exec comms + fallback model routing). Probability/Impact scored.

3) Procurement path: AlderTech to confirm limited-scope PO by 4/11 to target April 26th soft launch for core. If PO not confirmed by 4/11, Marissa will escalate to VP Sales to request CFO intervention and confirm a hard rebaseline to week of 5/24.

4) Meeting cadence: daily 15-minute stand through 4/11; then 2x/week until acceptance complete.

Helen — appreciate your flexibility. If procurement gives a hard no to a limited PO, please flag immediately so Marissa can move forward with escalation. I'll circulate the one-page exec packet after incorporating Marissa's edits (COB 4/6).

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: risk-log-template.csv, AlderTech_MAP_v1.pdf
